Vitenamese show and cuisine
Mar 2024 • Business
Situated near downtown Ho Chi Minh, is this enchanting colonial Vitenamese house turned into a restaurant serving Vitenamese cuisine. Popular with locals as well as tourist. They had a dish where the rice in a claypot was broken purposely and thrown in the air where another server catches the flying cooked rice to be served at the table. Its all show! The highlight was their stir fried pumpkin flower, deep fried soft shell crab. Other food was acceptable but no wow factor! Price was on the higher plain but service was good. A memorable dinner.

AUTHENTIC VIETNAMESE CUISINE WITH LIVE BAND
Jan 2024 • Friends
G4Fun selected our first group dinner at Com Nieu Sai Gon to try out Vietnamese cuisine. 
We selected the non AC part of the restaurant and had our seats right in front of the live band.
The restaurant has a very wide selection of basic food and high end entities. There were a number of pre-order items like wild boar. Other exotic dishes included special blood cockles, pond snails and clams.
Our group were subdivided into smaller groups of six. My group of six ordered the basic foods. 6 We had their signature clayport rice where one staff member will "throw" the cooked rice in the cooked pot from one end of the room for another member to "catch" the rice intact. 
The order taker recommended a special belly fish cooked with a unique sauce. This fish is very fresh and tasty. Also ate two kinds of vegetables and a chicken dish. We also selected seafood soup. All the dishes were satisfactory.
We also took the occasion to celebrate a member's birthday. This has been one tradition the G4Fun group has been practising for many years now, a legacy to cherish.

Written January 8, 2024

One of Anthony Bourdian’s featured restaurants
Oct 2019 • Couples
We have seen Anthony Bourdain’s show featuring this restaurant and decided to pay a visit here. Before we came to Saigon, we put this restaurant as one of our must visit places. Although a lot of reviewers at TripAdvisor didn’t like the clay pot rice due to it toughness. But the dish is how it supposed to be like. You have to let rice soak with the fish source to soften the browned rice then it would be easier to chew on. Their other famous dish is their clay pot fish. And lotus leaves fried rice.
